messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate detected for /v1/generate on router-service (prod, us-west-2). Alert group: deployment-errors. Severity: P2. Paging oncall.

deploy-bot: deployment started: roll/2026-03-15T14:05 - image=router-service:v2.14.3

nate: seeing spikes in 5xxs, looks correlated with the new rollout. errors from 14:07 UTC.

eva: confirmed 503/403 mix. sample log:
```
ERROR request_id=abc123 status=403 message="AccessDenied: decrypt failed" service=router kms_key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:cmk/xyz
```

alex: who deployed? @nate or deploy-bot? Is this the KMS change from the canary? 

nate: deploy-bot kicked it off, canary passed at 14:06 for a couple of requests but then failures started.

sre-lead: I'm oncall. Quick check: did the rollout include an env var change for KMS key ARN or a mount change? Those usually break decrypts.

nate: manifest shows env var KMS_KEY_ARN changed to new arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:cmk/new-rotated-key

eva: that new key was rotated yesterday but I thought rotation includes granting decrypt to the router-service role via service-account-kms-policy.

alex: IAM check:
```
aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::111:role/router-service-role --action-names kms:Decrypt --resource-arns arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:cmk/new-rotated-key
```

alex: result: denied. Looks like the rotated key's key policy doesn't include the role.

sre-lead: OK root cause likely missing key policy binding for the new CMK. Mitigation options: rollback deployment to previous image (old env var), or hotfix key policy to add decrypt for role.

nate: rollback is fastest. We have a kill-switch feature flag for this route, we can also flip that to route to fallback model instances.

eva: customers report elevated error rates — cs-olivia, any immediate customer complaints? 

cs-olivia: just got 2 SEV tickets from one customer (legaltech-app) reporting 5xxs. Support is triaging and BCCing affected customers with interim note.

sre-lead: decision call: perform immediate rollback of the rollout to v2.14.2 and open a followup to fix key policy. Rollback in progress.

deploy-bot: rolling back to router-service:v2.14.2 in prod us-west-2

nate: executing abort command:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/router-service --to-revision=203
```

alex: also creating temporary feature-flag kill:router-unified -> off to route traffic away from new path.

eva: applied flag off. Confirming flag propagation to CDN edge.

sre-lead: monitoring after rollback. watch for error rate and latency.

incident-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Update: rollback initiated at 2026-03-15T14:12:30Z by nate.

nate: pods from v2.14.2 are coming up, healthchecks pass.

eva: error rate dropping, 5xxs down to baseline in the last 60s :white_check_mark:

cs-olivia: told affected customers the team is rolling back and investigating; will follow up with root cause timeline.

sre-lead: postmortem action items:
- verify CMK key policy automation on rotation (add test that validates service role has Decrypt)
- add pre-deploy check that simulates principal policy for new KMS ARNs
- improve rollout canary to include KMS decrypt smoke test

alex: creating jira INCIDENT-4782 with these action items and owner assignments.

nate: temporary mitigation done. For completeness, I can patch key policy to include role but we should prefer automation. Who owns key rotation? 

eva: infra-keys team does, will sync and add the policy. I'll follow up with infra-keys and post the PR link.

sre-lead: oncall handoff note: leaving this in recovery. Handing to eva for follow-up. If error rate resurges re-pager.

eva: ack. I'll coordinate with infra-keys and the release lead to schedule a redeploy once key policy is confirmed.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident resolved for now — errors returned to baseline. Root cause: rotated KMS key missing decrypt permission for router-service role. Timeline and followup in INCIDENT-4782.

cs-olivia: customers updated, CS is happy with rollback note. We'll keep them posted with ETA for permanent fix.

nate: quick logs for audit:
```
14:05 deploy triggered roll/2026-03-15T14:05 image=v2.14.3
14:07 errors start -> AccessDenied KMS
14:12 rollback initiated
14:14 errors baseline
```

sre-lead: good run. Reminder: if fixes require key policy changes in prod, we must coordinate with security and infra-keys for audit trail.

eva: creating PR to infra-keys org: add router-service role to CMK key policy on rotation flow. Will link in INCIDENT-4782.

alex: closing thread, monitoring for 1hr post-rollback.

incident-bot: log archived to incidents/INCIDENT-4782/3100001234.log
